resources.string: Mindful app usage through gentle friction
Take back control of your screen time with breathing exercises, delays, and daily limits.
Nudge needs these permissions to work. No data is ever sent anywhere — the app has no internet permission.

Detects which app is in the foreground so Nudge can trigger your block rules. Also identifies in-app screens (like YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels) by checking navigation elements. Does not read your messages, keystrokes, or screen content.

Shows the delay countdown or breathing exercise overlay on top of blocked apps — this is how Nudge presents the pause before opening. Granting it also helps Nudge restart its own protection if Android stops it in the background. Either way, opening Nudge yourself always brings blocking back if it\'s stopped.
Tracks how long you use each app per day to enforce daily time budgets. Usage data is stored locally on your device only.
What do you want to block?
Keep Instagram, YouTube or TikTok and lose only the short videos. Turning a switch on takes effect at once.
You can change this any time on the Home screen.
Block more apps any time from the Apps tab
